gpio_apb_access.note: observed device bus access with the full APB probe set

gpio_consumption_match.note: device-side consumption match row; status accepted/unknown both mean the identity matched (rejected/incomplete never join), while origin lineage status is not part of this proof

gpio_pad_observation.note: raw pad sample: value only, no identity keys at all

gpio_register_commit.note: GPIO register committed from a real APB write; carries the full key

gpio_register_read.note: register readback witness; the read key must equal the store key

spi_transfer.note: declared SPI transfer endpoint; no producer in the studied artifacts

timer_tick.note: declared timer endpoint; no producer in the studied artifacts

uart_fifo_pop.note: device-internal FIFO entry pop; joins on the read access key

uart_fifo_push.note: FIFO push names entry_id/frame_id only; no exact store join exists

uart_rdata_access.note: UART data-register read access witness (read direction)

uart_serial_observation.note: raw serial sample: carries no store transaction key, so it joins by device identity plus an observed +1 counter step on the lane byte

uart_tick_observation_access.note: UART tick observation that carries a write access context
